brief: The canvas presents vast, overlapping rectangular planes of deeply saturated, resonant colors. These fields give the impression of floating and breathing, with the tones subtly bleeding into one another. Luminosity is enhanced at the edges where the masses overlap, defining a rich, profound transition between hues. The overall composition suggests a slow, continuous, ambient shift in color depth. When the user interacts with the canvas, the existing color transitions deepen dramatically, causing the overlapping masses to swell and sharpen their contrast.

statement: This sketch creates an ambient, evolving field of overlapping, floating rectangles that pulse and breathe with deep, saturated colors. The composition suggests a slow, continuous shift in color depth through subtle motion and luminosity changes. When a user interacts by clicking the canvas, the existing transitions deepen dramatically—causing overlapping masses to swell and sharpen their contrast. The visual effect emerges from layers of soft-edged rectangles drawn with alpha blending, glow effects, and layered transparency that create rich, organic transitions between hues.
